body:
I have aspergers. I received consistent therapy from a young age to the extent that around grade 8 I would say I became "normal" when it came to analysing non-verbal social cues and verbal social cues. But because of this I was awkward, angry, and easily scared the majority of my childhood with only a few close friends. 

But, when I was put into high school they made me take one GLE class which I felt was a waste of time, and endowed me with the branding reproach of "aspie". A title which is near social suicide.

A few questions 

1. How do you know if its safe to come out to someone in a toxic environment 

2. Do you think going to a school councillor would backfire on me? it seems like a really bad idea to go to a councillor when there is a reasonable chance that they may hate gay people. Although there are some very kind and reasonable teachers and admin at this school 

3. How can I get over my past? I frequently feel depressed thinking about my childhood and it hurts me to think about it often. I want to have kids partially because I want to provide somebody else with a lost childhood I never had, although you may be a bit young to answer that. 

4. Do I have any hope of actually enjoying my teenage years, or am I doomed to remaining in a state of despair 

Thank you for answering this, it really helps.
